statement: Given an undirected graph with positive integer edge weights and two nodes s and t. The query line is `2 s t`: k=2 is the NUMBER of arguments (not a type code), then s and t. Print the total weight of a minimum-weight path from s to t, or -1 if t is unreachable from s.

Given a directed graph and two nodes s and t. The query line is `2 s t`: k=2 is the NUMBER of arguments (not a type code), then s and t. Print YES if there is a directed path from s to t, otherwise NO.
Given an undirected graph, print the number of connected components (an isolated node is its own component).
Given an undirected simple graph, print YES if it contains at least one cycle, otherwise NO.
Given a connected undirected unweighted graph, print its diameter: the largest shortest-path distance (in edges) between any two nodes.
Given an undirected graph and two nodes u and v. The query line is `2 u v`: k=2 is the NUMBER of arguments (not a type code), then u and v. Print the number of nodes adjacent to both u and v.
Given an undirected simple graph, print the number of triangles (unordered triples of mutually adjacent nodes).
Given an undirected graph, print YES if its nodes can be split into two sets so that every edge joins the two sets (the graph is bipartite), otherwise NO.
Given a connected undirected graph with positive integer edge weights, print the total weight of a minimum spanning tree.
Given a directed graph whose edge weights are capacities and two nodes s and t (query 2 s t), print the value of a maximum flow from s to t.
